references.text: The basic law concerning the Feast of Tabernacles lasting seven days, as referred to in Deuteronomy 16:13
Instructions about sacrifices during the Feast of Tabernacles on the fifteenth day of the seventh month
The Feast of Ingathering is mentioned, which is celebrated when you gather the harvest from the fields
The Feast of Tabernacles is mentioned in connection with the harvest at the end of the year
The people celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after returning from exile, in accordance with the law
The prophecy that all nations will celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles in the future
John mentions that the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near, to which Jesus went up
